final: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS mean_of_avgs, AVG(r.cnt) AS mean_count, AVG(r.avg_amt - m.mean_avg) AS mean_excess FROM r, m WHERE r.avg_amt > m.mean_avg
